in_marathi.name: Lawkush
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lawkush हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lawkush is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu god Kubera, who is the lord of wealth and prosperity. The name symbolizes abundance, generosity, and prosperity.
